title: Meridian worker API bodies, for runs of plan version 1
description: The bodies of the worker API, as workerapi.Marshal writes them, for runs of plan version 1: each is one of the $defs, which the API's path says. The API has a version of its own, apart from the plan's: these are the bodies of its newest version, 3, and a member a version after 1 adds says which version that is, so that a body of an earlier version is one without it. What they carry of a run, its values, a ready job and the results of the jobs it needs, the plan's schemas describe, which these refer to. Whole numbers are written without a fraction or an exponent, as 2 and never 2.0, 2e0 or -0.0, which decoding refuses though JSON Schema can't tell them from integers; each integer's bounds are its Go type's, as a Go int has 32 bits on some systems.

ClaimRequest.description: What a worker claims an attempt with, which never changes.

credential.description: The credential the worker made, which is the attempt's from then on.

apiVersion.description: The newest version of the worker API the worker speaks: it speaks every version up to it. A worker of a release from before the API had a version of its own leaves it out, and speaks version 1.

planVersion.description: The newest plan version the worker reads.

Worker.description: The meridian binary that runs an attempt.

digest.description: sha256: and the hex of its binary's SHA-256 digest.

Claim.description: An attempt that a worker claimed: the job as Ready evaluated it, with all of the run that the job reads.

apiVersion.description: The version of the worker API the attempt is served at, which both sides speak until it ends: the lower of the worker's and the coordinator's.

planVersion.description: The version of the run's plan, which job is encoded in: this one's.

job.description: The job as Ready evaluated it, as plan.EncodeReadyJob writes it.

run.description: The run's values that the job reads.

needs.description: The results of the jobs it needs, by name.

runDirOnMember.description: Added in worker API version 3. Set when the member chose the run's directory itself, as a host the ssh backend reaches does, apart from the run's directory where the run started: format 1's copy of it on a host, where a step never cleans the directory of a run it calls.

control.description: Added in worker API version 2. What the coordinator asks of the worker as of the claim, which the worker does as it asks before anything of the job runs. A claim of version 1 has none.

tree.description: Added in worker API version 3. What an attempt of a child run has of its tree. A claim of a run no step called, or of an earlier version, has none.

EnvVar.description: A variable the platform gives the job's steps.

Tree.description: What an attempt of a child run has of its tree: its root's identity, and the strings the worker of the step that called it masked. Every member is of worker API version 3.

jobID.description: Added in worker API version 3. The root run's ID, which the job's steps read as PW_JOB_ID.

rootDir.description: Added in worker API version 3. The root run's directory on the worker's host, in which the run's is, which the job's steps read as PW_PARENT_JOB_DIR.

workflowName.description: Added in worker API version 3. Format 1's name for the call that made the run, which the job's steps read as PW_WORKFLOW_NAME.

masked.description: Added in worker API version 3. The strings the worker of the step that called the run masked, which the job's phases count as secrets' own texts.

Container.description: The container the job's steps run in.

Control.description: What the coordinator tells a running attempt.

Events.description: Events of an attempt's steps, in order.

Event.description: A step's try, or its cleanup, started or finished.

lastTry.description: Added in worker API version 2. Set on the finished event of a step's try that failed, when the step won't be tried again. An event of version 1 has none.

EventsAck.description: The last event the coordinator has stored.

LogAck.description: How much of a log the coordinator has stored.

ActionRequest.description: Added in worker API version 3. A step's try asks the coordinator for the built-in action it uses, which the coordinator reads from the run's plan, at the step. A repeat is given the same answer, and one with another with: is refused.

step.description: Added in worker API version 3. The step's index in its job, from 0.

try.description: Added in worker API version 3. The step's try: 0 for its first run.

with.description: Added in worker API version 3. The step's with:, as Step evaluated it for the try: a mapping.

private.description: Added in worker API version 3. Set when evaluating with: read a variable or a password, which makes what it gives private.

secret.description: Added in worker API version 3. Set when evaluating with: read a secret, which makes what it gives masked.

ActionAnswer.description: Added in worker API version 3. How the action an ActionRequest asked for ended, with its problems.

outcome.description: Added in worker API version 3. How the action ended: success or failure; or cancelled, for one the coordinator didn't perform.

reason.description: Added in worker API version 3. Why the attempt's control asks to cancel its job as the action is answered, never for the run's timeout: with the outcome cancelled, why the action wasn't performed; with another, a cancel that came with it. The outcome cancelled without one is the step's early-cancel:, as a job of the run failed.

diagnostics.description: Added in worker API version 3. The action's problems.

ChildRequest.description: Added in worker API version 3. A step's try asks for the child run of the workflow its uses: names, which the coordinator reads from the run's plan, at the step. A repeat is answered with the same child.

step.description: Added in worker API version 3. The step's index in its job, from 0.

try.description: Added in worker API version 3. The step's try, from 0.

with.description: Added in worker API version 3. The step's with:, as Step evaluated it, which the child is submitted: a mapping.

env.description: Added in worker API version 3. The step's environment, which the child's env: is laid over.

withPrivate.description: Added in worker API version 3. The parts of with: made from a variable or a password but no secret, by their paths.

withSecrets.description: Added in worker API version 3. The parts of with: made from a secret, by their paths.

envPrivate.description: Added in worker API version 3. The variables of env made from a variable or a password but no secret.

envSecrets.description: Added in worker API version 3. The variables of env made from a secret.

masked.description: Added in worker API version 3. The strings the worker masks for the step, which the child's jobs mask too.

workingDirectory.description: Added in worker API version 3. The step's own working-directory:, relative to its run's directory or absolute, which is the child's directory; or none, and then the child's is subworkflows/<job>/step_<n> in its run's.

Child.description: Added in worker API version 3. The child run of a step's try, as it is.

run.description: Added in worker API version 3. The child run's ID, or none for a child that wasn't made.

ended.description: Added in worker API version 3. Set once the child has ended.

outcome.description: Added in worker API version 3. How the child run ended, once it has.

reason.description: Added in worker API version 3. Why the child ended other than as its jobs did.

diagnostics.description: Added in worker API version 3. Why a child that wasn't made wasn't.

ChildStop.description: Added in worker API version 3. Stops the child run of a step's try.

step.description: Added in worker API version 3. The step's index in its job, from 0.

try.description: Added in worker API version 3. The step's try, from 0.

reason.description: Added in worker API version 3. Why the step is stopped: cancelled, or timeout.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem, as foundation's problem.Problem writes it.
